lines.english: # Workflow: Borrowing Lifecycle
lines.canonical: # 工作流：借鉴闭环

lines.english: This workflow defines only role transitions, state transitions, approvals, recovery and completion boundaries. The single Skill owns operator steps; governance rules own field, safety and permission decisions.
lines.canonical: 本工作流只定义角色切换、状态流转、审批、恢复和完成边界。面向操作者的步骤由唯一 Skill 承接，字段、安全与权限判断回到治理规则。

lines.english: ## Entry conditions
lines.canonical: ## 进入条件

lines.english: Marker combinations describe facts about the root directory; RootMode values drive machine branches. Do not conflate them.
lines.canonical: marker 组合名用于描述根目录事实，RootMode 值用于机器分支，两者不得混用。

lines.english: | Marker combination | Actual RootMode result | Workflow authority |
lines.canonical: | marker 组合 | RootMode 实际返回值 | workflow 权限 |

lines.english: | project-only | project | Write-mode intake, card creation and state changes allowed |
lines.canonical: | project-only | project | 允许写入型接入/建卡/状态变更 |

lines.english: | template-only | template | Read-only P4t audit in template mode only |
lines.canonical: | template-only | template | 仅允许模板模式只读 P4t 审计 |

lines.english: | No marker | unknown | Zero writes; hard failure |
lines.canonical: | 无标记 | unknown | 零写入；硬失败 |

lines.english: | Both markers | conflict | Zero writes; hard failure |
lines.canonical: | 双标记 | conflict | 零写入；硬失败 |

lines.english: RootMode returns only `project` / `template` / `unknown` / `conflict`; it must not return human labels such as “project mode” or “template mode.”
lines.canonical: RootMode 函数只返回 `project` / `template` / `unknown` / `conflict`；禁止返回“项目模式”“模板模式”等人类标签。

lines.english: Write-mode flows must check the mode before creating staging, cards or local state. No non-project mode may enter a write branch. Template mode runs only an offline, read-only template audit; unknown and conflict fail immediately.
lines.canonical: 写入型流程必须在创建 staging、卡片或本地状态前完成模式检查；非 project 一律不得进入写入分支。template 只运行离线、只读的模板审计，unknown 与 conflict 立即失败。

lines.english: ## Role flow
lines.canonical: ## 角色流

lines.english: | Role | Responsibility in this lifecycle | Write boundary |
lines.canonical: | 角色 | 本闭环职责 | 写入边界 |

lines.english: | Project PM | Orchestration and routing | Does not expand its path allowlist |
lines.canonical: | 项目 PM | 编排与路由 | 不借此扩大路径白名单 |

lines.english: | Operating System PM | Manage sources and cards | 借鉴区/** and the framework allowlist |
lines.canonical: | 操作系统 PM | 管理来源与卡片 | 借鉴区/** 与 framework 白名单 |

lines.english: | Target decision PM | Provide domain assessment only | Does not write source cards or item cards |
lines.canonical: | 目标决策 PM | 仅提供领域评估结论 | 不写来源卡或事项卡 |

lines.english: | Test PM | Define verification strategy | Does not replace the PM responsible for the target path |
lines.canonical: | 测试 PM | 制定验证策略 | 不替代目标路径责任 PM |

lines.english: Implementation must be routed again according to the target file's path. A borrowing item creates no additional write authority.
lines.canonical: 落地必须重新按目标文件所在路径路由，借鉴事项本身不产生额外写权限。

lines.english: | Target path | Responsible PM / implementation runtime |
lines.canonical: | 目标路径 | 责任 PM/实施载体 |

lines.english: | framework | Operating System PM |
lines.canonical: | framework | 操作系统 PM |

lines.english: | requirements | Product PM |
lines.canonical: | 需求 | 产品 PM |

lines.english: | business / test code | Development PM |
lines.canonical: | 业务/测试代码 | 开发 PM |

lines.english: | release | Test and Release PM; separate authorization still required |
lines.canonical: | 发布 | 测试发布 PM；仍需另行授权 |

lines.english: ## State flow
lines.canonical: ## 状态流

lines.english: Each change must follow an adjacent transition in this table.
lines.canonical: 每次变化只允许采用下表中的相邻转换。

lines.english: | Previous state | New state | decision / conditions |
lines.canonical: | 旧状态 | 新状态 | decision/条件 |

lines.english: | none | draft | pending; first record |
lines.canonical: | none | draft | pending；首次记录 |

lines.english: | draft | assessing | pending; at least one ready capture |
lines.canonical: | draft | assessing | pending；至少一个 ready capture |

lines.english: | assessing | implementation_ready | adopt / adapt; Q1-Q7, L1-L4 and approval passed |
lines.canonical: | assessing | implementation_ready | adopt / adapt；Q1-Q7、L1-L4 与审批通过 |

lines.english: | assessing | parked | defer; resume condition or review time recorded |
lines.canonical: | assessing | parked | defer；有恢复条件或复查时间 |

lines.english: | assessing | closed | reject; assessment evidence and rejection reason; enter the closure transaction |
lines.canonical: | assessing | closed | reject；有评估证据与拒绝理由；进入关闭事务 |

lines.english: | parked | assessing | pending / adopt / adapt / reject / defer; resume condition met |
lines.canonical: | parked | assessing | pending / adopt / adapt / reject / defer；恢复条件满足 |

lines.english: | implementation_ready | implementing | adopt / adapt; scope and responsible role determined |
lines.canonical: | implementation_ready | implementing | adopt / adapt；范围与责任角色确定 |

lines.english: | implementing | verifying | adopt / adapt; implementation record exists |
lines.canonical: | implementing | verifying | adopt / adapt；实施记录存在 |

lines.english: | verifying | closed | adopt / adapt; fresh verification evidence complete; enter the closure transaction |
lines.canonical: | verifying | closed | adopt / adapt；fresh 验证证据完成；进入关闭事务 |

lines.english: | Any active state | cancelled | Any decision; cancellation reason recorded |
lines.canonical: | 任一活动状态 | cancelled | 任意；有取消原因 |

lines.english: Every implementation state from `implementation_ready` through `closed` individually constrains source bindings: `adopt` requires every capture to have `reuse_scope=copy-internal-approved`; `adapt` requires every capture to have `reuse_scope=adapt-internal-approved`. Other scopes create no implicit permission hierarchy.
lines.canonical: 从 `implementation_ready` 到 `closed` 的所有实施状态均逐一约束来源绑定：`adopt` 要求每个 capture 的 `reuse_scope=copy-internal-approved`，`adapt` 要求每个 capture 的 `reuse_scope=adapt-internal-approved`；其他范围不建立隐式权限层级。

lines.english: `blocked=true is allowed only in active states`; also record `blocked_from`, `reason` and `resume_condition`. Unblocking returns to the original state.
lines.canonical: `blocked=true 只允许活动状态`，并同时记录 `blocked_from`、`reason`、`resume_condition`；解除后回到原状态。

lines.english: Appending evidence without changing state is allowed only in active states.
lines.canonical: 同状态追加证据仅限活动状态。

lines.english: closed/cancelled are immutable terminal states; later changes require a new supersedes item.
lines.canonical: closed/cancelled 为终态且不可修改；后续变化必须新建 supersedes。

lines.english: Every state change must append history with nondecreasing timestamps. The last history row's lifecycle_status must match current frontmatter; its decision must also match current frontmatter.
lines.canonical: 状态变化必须追加历史，时间非递减。历史末行的 lifecycle_status 与 frontmatter 当前值一致；历史末行的 decision 与 frontmatter 当前值一致。

lines.english: ## Decisions and approval
lines.canonical: ## 决策与审批

lines.english: - `pending` means no adoption conclusion yet; it does not permit implementation.
lines.canonical: - `pending` 只表示尚未形成采纳结论，不可据此进入实施。

lines.english: - Before `adopt` or `adapt` enters implementation readiness, complete Q1-Q7, L1-L4 and required approvals. The role responsible for the target path still performs the implementation.
lines.canonical: - `adopt` 或 `adapt` 进入实施准备前，必须完成 Q1-Q7、L1-L4 与所需审批；实际落地仍由目标路径责任角色执行。

lines.english: - `reject` requires assessment evidence and a rejection reason before closure.
lines.canonical: - `reject` 必须留下评估证据和拒绝理由后才能关闭。

lines.english: - `defer` must enter parked and record a resume condition or review time.
lines.canonical: - `defer` 必须进入 parked，并留下恢复条件或复查时间。

lines.english: For governance changes, remote actions, execution, deletion or publication, refer to the existing A/B/C rules. This workflow does not create a separate authorization policy.
lines.canonical: 涉及治理调整、远端动作、执行、删除或发布时，只引用现有 A/B/C 判断，不在本工作流另建授权口径。

lines.english: ## Failure recovery
lines.canonical: ## 失败恢复

lines.english: Promotion of a captured source follows a fixed two-gate sequence. The pre-promotion root P4t checks the existing official root; the candidate validator checks the staging candidate.
lines.canonical: 来源捕获的正式晋升固定为双闸顺序；晋升前根 P4t 检查现有正式根，staging 候选由 candidate validator 校验。

lines.english: | Order | Capture-promotion step | Exact result |
lines.canonical: | 顺序 | 捕获晋升步骤 | 精确结果 |

lines.english: | 1 | candidate validator / candidate validation | Staging candidate card may declare capture_status: ready; exit 0 |
lines.canonical: | 1 | candidate validator/候选校验 | staging 候选卡可声明 capture_status: ready；exit 0 |

lines.english: | 2 | Pre-promotion root P4t | exit 0 |
lines.canonical: | 2 | 晋升前根 P4t | exit 0 |

lines.english: | 3 | Atomic move | staging → target capture |
lines.canonical: | 3 | 原子移动 | staging→目标 capture |

lines.english: | 4 | Post-promotion root P4t | exit 0 |
lines.canonical: | 4 | 晋升后根 P4t | exit 0 |

lines.english: | 5 | Official ready | Confirm/output only after both root P4t runs exit 0 |
lines.canonical: | 5 | 正式 ready | 前后根 P4t 均 exit 0 后才确认/输出 |

lines.english: | Event | Exact result |
lines.canonical: | 事件 | 精确结果 |

lines.english: | candidate validator or either root P4t exits 5/10 | Must not promote to ready |
lines.canonical: | candidate validator 或任一根 P4t exit 5/10 | 不得晋升为 ready |

lines.english: | Post-promotion root P4t exits 5/10 | Atomically move back to staging; must not retain ready |
lines.canonical: | 晋升后根 P4t exit 5/10 | 原子移回 staging；不得保留 ready |

lines.english: | Standalone audit exits 5 | WARN only; must not advance any state |
lines.canonical: | 独立审计 exit 5 | 仅 WARN；不得推进任何状态 |

lines.english: | Standalone audit exits 10 | FAIL; hard failure; must not advance any state or perform repair writes |
lines.canonical: | 独立审计 exit 10 | FAIL；硬失败；不得推进任何状态；不得修复写入 |

lines.english: A failed capture creates no official ready capture. Ignored staging may remain; report the failure stage and path. A post-promotion failure rolls back only the newly added directory and does not affect existing sources or items.
lines.canonical: 捕获失败不生成 ready 的正式 capture；允许保留被忽略的 staging，并报告失败阶段与路径。后验失败只回退本次新增目录，不影响既有来源或事项。

lines.english: A failed refresh leaves old captures and items untouched. An unchanged fingerprint returns REUSED; only a changed fingerprint creates a new capture. Existing items retain their original source_id + capture_id + fingerprint references and must not automatically follow a new capture.
lines.canonical: 刷新失败时，旧 capture 与旧事项不受影响。刷新时 fingerprint 不变返回 REUSED；fingerprint 改变才新增 capture。旧事项保持原 source_id + capture_id + fingerprint 引用，不得自动跟随新 capture。

lines.english: Failed verification remains in verifying and appends failure evidence. Do not reset or silently delete user changes, cards or evidence.
lines.canonical: 验证失败时保留在 verifying，追加失败证据；不 reset，不静默删除用户改动、卡片或证据。

lines.english: ## Completion conditions
lines.canonical: ## 完成条件

lines.english: Only the Skill may invoke `close-borrowing-item.ps1` to close an item. The entry first calls `seal-borrowing-item.ps1`, then runs the full root P4t. After exit 0, it must still hold the final lock while rechecking the official card's identity, length and sealed bytes, and clean this transaction's staging under that lock. Confirm closed externally only after every step succeeds.
lines.canonical: 关闭只能由 Skill 调用 `close-borrowing-item.ps1`；入口先调用 `seal-borrowing-item.ps1`，再运行完整根 P4t；exit 0 后还必须持终锁复核正式卡的身份、长度与 sealed 字节，并在锁内清理本事务 staging，全部成功才能对外确认 closed。

lines.english: Candidate installation and seal commit both use no-overwrite; neither may overwrite a concurrent writer or later object. When seal material binds the current official object and only `borrow_id` differs, ownership remains provable and the complete snapshot can safely restore the original active card. Other `seal-ownership-unproven` outcomes must preserve the current official card and staging. Do not roll back the official card after the irreversible `content-deleted` completion point.
lines.canonical: 候选安装与 seal 提交都使用 no-overwrite，不得覆盖并发写者或后来对象。seal 材料已绑定当前正式对象、仅 `borrow_id` 不一致时，ownership 仍可证明，可按完整快照安全恢复原活动卡；其他 `seal-ownership-unproven` 必须保留当前正式卡与 staging。进入 `content-deleted` 不可逆完成点后不回滚正式卡。

lines.english: The staging ownership chain is fixed: atomically create the staging directory relative to a trusted parent-directory handle. Create the first `原活动卡.bin` using directory-handle-relative CreateNew; write, flush and bind through that same handle. Retain the file lease throughout the transaction so the directory stays nonempty. Create candidate `借鉴卡.md` with directory-handle-relative CreateNew as well.
lines.canonical: staging 所有权链固定：通过受信父目录句柄相对原子创建 staging 目录；首个 `原活动卡.bin` 以目录句柄相对 CreateNew，并在同一 handle 写入、flush 并绑定，文件 lease 贯穿整个事务以让目录保持非空；候选 `借鉴卡.md` 也以目录句柄相对 CreateNew。

lines.english: Cleanup order is fixed as `Candidate→retained Original→content-deleted→directory`: validate Candidate through a single-open bound handle and set delete-pending through that same handle; set retained Original delete-pending through its retained lease and same handle; immediately enter `content-deleted`, then delete the directory through its original creation handle. Leave no gap between verification and path opening. Failed creation deletes only objects bound to this transaction's handles.
lines.canonical: 清理顺序固定为 `Candidate→retained Original→content-deleted→directory`：Candidate 以单次打开的绑定 handle 完成验证并在同一 handle 设置 delete-pending；retained Original 通过保留 lease 在同一 handle 设置 delete-pending；随后立即进入 `content-deleted`，最后由目录创建句柄同句柄删除。验证与路径打开之间不得留窗口；创建失败只删除本事务句柄绑定对象。

lines.english: After P4t exit 0, acquire the official card's final lock with one OPEN_REPARSE_POINT open. Through the same handle, recheck canonical path, regular non-reparse type, link count=1, identity, length and bytes. Hold that exclusive lease until staging cleanup finishes. Do not validate a safe path and then reopen it by path.
lines.canonical: P4t exit 0 后，正式卡终锁必须单次 OPEN_REPARSE_POINT 打开，并从同一 handle 复核 canonical path、常规非 reparse 类型、link count=1、identity、length 与 bytes；该排他 lease 持有到 staging 清理结束。禁止“先安全路径验证再按路径重开”。

lines.english: Post-seal staging-candidate updates follow a two-state contract: the official-card ownership snapshot and current staging-candidate snapshot are separate states, each independently verified during rollback. Do not change the expected staging state to sealed bytes in advance. After `Set-BctCandidateBytes` commits its Set, update the state object before any later check that may fail, so exception paths see the candidate actually committed.
lines.canonical: seal 后 staging 候选更新遵循双状态合同：正式卡所有权快照与当前 staging 候选快照是两个独立状态，回滚必须分别验证；不得提前把 staging 期望改成 sealed 字节。`Set-BctCandidateBytes` 的 Set 提交后状态对象先更新，再执行后续可失败复核，确保异常分支看到实际已提交候选。

lines.english: - adopt/adapt: target scope, adaptation differences, implementation record, fresh verification evidence, seal and P4t exit 0 must all hold.
lines.canonical: - adopt/adapt：目标范围、适配差异、实施记录、fresh 验证证据、seal 与 P4t exit 0 全部成立。

lines.english: - reject: assessment evidence, rejection reason, seal and P4t exit 0 must all hold.
lines.canonical: - reject：评估证据、拒绝理由、seal 与 P4t exit 0 全部成立。

lines.english: - cancelled: complete cancellation reason; parked is not completion.
lines.canonical: - cancelled：取消原因完整；parked 不视为完成。

lines.english: - Do not claim ready before the P4t gates pass; do not claim closed before the closure transaction completes its final-lock verification and cleanup under lock.
lines.canonical: - P4t 闸门通过前不得宣称 ready；关闭事务完成终锁复核与锁内清理前不得宣称 closed。

lines.english: ### Closure transaction
lines.canonical: ### 关闭事务

lines.english: | Closure order | Exact action | Failure boundary |
lines.canonical: | 关闭顺序 | 精确动作 | 失败边界 |

lines.english: | 1 | Retain original active-card bytes | Externally, the original active state still applies |
lines.canonical: | 1 | 保留原活动卡字节 | 对外仍为原活动状态 |

lines.english: | 2 | Construct a closed candidate | Set state and history to closed; closure_seal_sha256 empty |
lines.canonical: | 2 | 构造 closed 候选 | 状态与历史写为 closed；closure_seal_sha256 为空 |

lines.english: | 3 | Install candidate with no-overwrite and call seal-borrowing-item.ps1 | A seal-helper failure must not claim closed or overwrite a later object |
lines.canonical: | 3 | 以 no-overwrite 装入候选并调用 seal-borrowing-item.ps1 | seal helper 失败不得宣称 closed；不得覆盖后来对象 |

lines.english: | 4 | Run root P4t | exit 0 enters final-lock verification only; must not output closed |
lines.canonical: | 4 | 运行根 P4t | exit 0 仅进入终锁复核；不得输出 closed |

lines.english: | 5 | Verify under the final lock and clean staging | Identity, length and sealed bytes stable; deleting both owned contents enters the irreversible content-deleted point; output closed only after directory cleanup succeeds |
lines.canonical: | 5 | 持终锁复核并清理 staging | 身份、长度、sealed 字节稳定；删除两份 owned 内容后进入 content-deleted 不可逆完成点；目录清理成功才输出 closed |

lines.english: | Provable failure | Restore original active card only while ownership is provable and content-deleted has not been reached; retain failed candidate in ignored staging | Explicitly report failure stage and canonical path; must not claim closed |
lines.canonical: | 可证明失败 | ownership 可证明且尚未进入 content-deleted 时恢复原活动卡；失败候选保留到被忽略 staging | 显式报告失败阶段与规范化路径；不得宣称 closed |

lines.english: | Unproven ownership or irreversible completion | seal-ownership-unproven preserves current official card and staging; no rollback of official card after content-deleted | Preserve auditable remnants and fail explicitly; do not overwrite or guess how to recover |
lines.canonical: | 所有权不明或不可逆 | seal-ownership-unproven 保留当前正式卡与 staging；content-deleted 后不回滚正式卡 | 保留可审计残留并显式失败；禁止覆盖或猜测恢复 |

lines.english: This transaction applies to both adopt/adapt and reject. Roll back only while the transaction's ownership of the official object is provable and content-deleted has not been reached. seal-ownership-unproven and failures after the irreversible point preserve evidence without rolling back the official card.
lines.canonical: 该事务同时适用于 adopt/adapt 与 reject；只有仍能证明正式对象由本事务拥有且尚未进入 content-deleted 才回滚；seal-ownership-unproven 或不可逆后的失败保留证据且不回滚正式卡。

lines.english: Completing the borrowing lifecycle is not publication; publication still requires separate authorization.
lines.canonical: 完成借鉴闭环不等于发布；发布仍需另行授权。
